method: Remove complete old/new CNN families; renormalize remaining family weights; keep geometry and transduction parameters fixed. Saved held-out predictions only; no model fitting.
old_cnn: two SWAD.1 Shallow16 seeds, T4 inside original prior
new_cnn: two latent_meanstd_p10 seeds, T1, balance1 in late fusion
scope: Family-level pruning only; not individual seed or tree pruning.
